title: Expected Points push
description: What the home machine's ffp run POSTs to /api/expected-points: each priced player's Expected Points and per-Scoring-Stat means for an NFL Week's Games that haven't kicked off, plus the Sleeper-to-ESPN id map for the ESPN projection fallback. Signed as in site/contracts/push-signature.json. Terms as in GLOSSARY.md.

week.description: ESPN's and Sleeper's numbering: regular season 1–18, postseason 1 (Wild Card) to 4 or 5 (Super Bowl), as ESPN numbers them; ESPN counts a Pro Bowl week when there is one.

sleeperId.description: Sleeper player id (the team for a D/ST), mapped on the home machine: Sleeper's player list by gsis_id, else nflverse's roster sleeper_id, else a unique name + team match. The Worker never downloads that list (14.7 MB).

gsisId.description: nflverse gsis_id; null for a D/ST.

espnId.description: ESPN player id from Sleeper's player list, else nflverse's roster; null if unmapped or a D/ST.

kickoff.description: The Game's kickoff. The push only lists players whose Game hasn't kicked off at generatedAt; /api/expected-points keeps an earlier push's entry for a player whose Game has kicked off (frozen at kickoff).

statMeans.description: Mean of each Scoring Stat for the whole Game. QB/RB/WR/TE: ffp.scoring's offensive stats. K: pat_made, pat_missed, fg_missed and FGs made by Sleeper's distance buckets (fgm_0_19 … fgm_60p, as site/contracts/scoring-rules.json sleeperFgBuckets). D/ST: ffp.scoring's D/ST counts plus points_allowed_all, opponent_defensive_tds_points, opponent_return_tds_points and yards_allowed. A missing stat is 0. The Projected Total is current + mean × fraction of the Game left, per stat, then scored.

expected.description: Expected Points (the Score Distribution's mean) by Scoring Rules name; every Leaderboard Scoring Rules option (ppr, half-ppr, standard, espn-league).

idMap.description: Sleeper player id → ESPN player id, for every QB/RB/WR/TE/K on a team that plays this NFL Week (priced or not), from Sleeper's player list, else nflverse's roster. The Worker joins ESPN's projections to Sleeper ids through it.
